description: Checks a buy-renovate-sell deal in South Africa: purchase price, renovation estimate, transfer duty and costs, holding costs and selling costs (agent commission) against expected resale value. Returns profit, margin and the maximum sensible offer for a target margin.

monthly_holding_cost.description: Rates, levies, insurance, utilities, bond interest. Default 1% of purchase price

renovation_cost.description: Total incl. VAT, e.g. from estimate_works

target_margin_pct.description: Target profit as % of total cost

name: renovation_flip_check
title: Check if a fix-and-flip deal adds up
